data.title: Daily Timeline: Ordering the events of a school day

challenges.title: A School Day
challenges.instruction: Put these school day events in the correct order from morning to night.

events.label: Wake Up
events.description: Get out of bed and get dressed for the day.

events.label: Morning Homeroom
events.description: Arrive at school and listen to morning announcements.

events.label: Eat Lunch
events.description: Enjoy a midday meal in the cafeteria with classmates.

events.label: Board the Bus
events.description: Ride the school bus back home at the end of the day.

events.label: Go to Sleep
events.description: Tuck into bed after finishing homework and relaxing.

challenges.hint: Think about what you do first when you wake up for school.
challenges.narration: Let us put a normal school day in the correct order!

challenges.title: A Weekend Day
challenges.instruction: Put these weekend events in the correct order from morning to night.

events.label: Sleep In
events.description: Wake up slowly on a relaxing Saturday morning.

events.label: Soccer Practice
events.description: Run drills and play a game on the field.

events.label: Eat Pizza
events.description: Have a tasty lunch with family in the afternoon.

events.label: Bike Ride
events.description: Cycle around the neighborhood before sunset.

events.label: Watch a Movie
events.description: Enjoy a family film together before going to bed.

challenges.hint: On the weekend, you might sleep in a little later before playing.
challenges.narration: Weekend days are fun and full of different activities!

challenges.title: A Holiday Party
challenges.instruction: Put these holiday events in the correct order from morning to night.

events.label: Open Presents
events.description: Unwrap gifts early in the morning with excitement.

events.label: Bake Cookies
events.description: Mix sweet treats in the kitchen with family.

events.label: Greet Guests
events.description: Welcome family and friends as they arrive at the door.

events.label: Feast Dinner
events.description: Sit down together to enjoy a large holiday meal.

events.label: See Fireworks
events.description: Watch colorful lights fill the night sky outside.

challenges.hint: Think about getting ready before guests arrive.
challenges.narration: Holidays are special days packed with fun moments!

challenges.title: A Summer Day
challenges.instruction: Put these warm weather events in the correct order from morning to night.

events.label: Put on Sunscreen
events.description: Protect your skin before heading out into the sun.

events.label: Swim in Pool
events.description: Splash around in the cool water to beat the heat.

events.label: Eat Ice Cream
events.description: Enjoy a sweet cold treat on a hot afternoon.

events.label: Catch Fireflies
events.description: Hunt for glowing bugs in the yard as twilight begins.

events.label: Stargaze Outdoors
events.description: Look up at the constellations before heading inside.

challenges.hint: Hot summer days usually involve cooling off in the water.
challenges.narration: Summer days are long and filled with outdoor fun!
